//@version=5
strategy("Delta Volume Breakout Night Shift Redesign 2", overlay=true,
  initial_capital=50000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1,
  commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=5.50,
  slippage=1, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false,
  max_bars_back=5000)
// ===== RISK =====
pv                = input.float(50, "Point Value ($)")
stop_dollars      = input.int(250, "Stop ($)", minval=250, maxval=700)
tp_dollars        = input.int(500, "Take Profit ($)", minval=250)
use_trail         = input.bool(false, "Enable Trailing Stop")
trail_pct         = input.float(50, "Trail keep (%)", minval=0, maxval=100)
trail_step_amt    = input.int(500, "Trail: Tighten every ($)", minval=0, maxval=2000)
trail_step_pct    = input.float(50, "Trail step (%)", minval=0, maxval=100)
trail_min_dollars = input.int(1000, "Trail: Min Profit ($)", minval=0, maxval=2000)
long_stop = strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_dollars / pv : close - stop_dollars / pv
long_limit = close + tp_dollars / pv
short_stop = strategy.position_size < 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price + stop_dollars / pv : close + stop_dollars / pv
short_limit = close - tp_dollars / pv
if strategy.position_size != 0 and not na(stop_dollars)
    if strategy.openprofit <= -stop_dollars
        strategy.close_all(comment="Open P&L > SL Risk")



// ===== PROFILE =====
profile_lookback = input.int(120, "Profile Lookback (bars)", minval=20, maxval=2000, step=10)
profile_rows     = input.int(10, "Price Levels (rows)", minval=5, maxval=100, step=5)
min_delta_pct    = input.float(10.0, "Min Delta Imbalance (%)", minval=0, maxval=80, step=5)

// ===== TREND & PIVOT =====
vwma_len         = input.int(20, "VWMA Length", minval=1)
pivot_len        = input.int(2, "Pivot Length", minval=1)

// ===== REVERSAL =====
use_post_stop_reversal = input.bool(true, "Use Post-Stop Reversal")
reversal_window_bars   = input.int(5, "Reversal Window (bars)", minval=1)

// ===== SESSION =====
sess_start_hr = input.int(18, "Session Start Hour (ET)")
sess_start_mn = input.int(0,  "Session Start Minute")
sess_end_hr   = input.int(16, "Session End Hour (ET)")
sess_end_mn   = input.int(0,  "Session End Minute")

// ===== COMPUTED =====
float stop_pts = stop_dollars / pv
float tp_pts   = tp_dollars / pv
var float prev_poc_hi = na
var float prev_poc_lo = na
var float prev_poc_delta_pct = na

// ===== SESSION LOGIC =====
bar_hr = hour(time, "America/New_York")
bar_mn = minute(time, "America/New_York")
bar_t  = bar_hr * 100 + bar_mn

int s_start = sess_start_hr * 100 + sess_start_mn
int s_end   = sess_end_hr * 100 + sess_end_mn

// Session is 18:00 to 16:00 (wraps around midnight)
bool in_session = (bar_t >= s_start) or (bar_t < s_end)

// Detect session end (16:00)
bool is_session_end_bar = (bar_t == s_end)

if is_session_end_bar and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session Close")

// ===== TREND FILTER (VWMA) =====
float vwma_val = ta.vwma(close, vwma_len)
bool trend_long = close > vwma_val
bool trend_short = close < vwma_val

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE WITH DELTA =====
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price = na
float poc_hi    = na
float poc_lo    = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row   = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    // Reset arrays
    if vol_total.size() != rows
        vol_total.clear()
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_total.push(0.0)
    else
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_total.set(i, 0.0)
            
    if vol_up.size() != rows
        vol_up.clear()
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_up.push(0.0)
    else
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_up.set(i, 0.0)
            
    if vol_dn.size() != rows
        vol_dn.clear()
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_dn.push(0.0)
    else
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_dn.set(i, 0.0)

    // Build Profile
    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1

        if span <= 0
            continue

        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                vol_total.set(r, vol_total.get(r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    vol_up.set(r, vol_up.get(r) + per_row)
                else
                    vol_dn.set(r, vol_dn.get(r) + per_row)

    // Find POC
    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_total.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    // Delta at POC
    float poc_up  = vol_up.get(poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = vol_dn.get(poc_row)
    float poc_tot = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

prev_poc_hi := poc_hi
prev_poc_lo := poc_lo
prev_poc_delta_pct := poc_delta_pct

// ===== ARM LOGIC =====
var bool armed_long = false
var bool armed_short = false

// Arm Long: Cross above POC High, Trend Long, Delta Bull
bool cross_above_poc = not na(prev_poc_hi) and close > prev_poc_hi and close[1] <= prev_poc_hi
bool cross_below_poc = not na(prev_poc_lo) and close < prev_poc_lo and close[1] >= prev_poc_lo

bool delta_bull = not na(prev_poc_delta_pct) and prev_poc_delta_pct > min_delta_pct
bool delta_bear = not na(prev_poc_delta_pct) and prev_poc_delta_pct < -min_delta_pct

if cross_above_poc and trend_long and delta_bull
    armed_long := true
else if cross_below_poc and trend_short and delta_bear
    armed_short := true

// Disarm Long: Close <= POC High
if armed_long and not na(prev_poc_hi) and close <= prev_poc_hi
    armed_long := false

// Disarm Short: Close >= POC Low
if armed_short and not na(prev_poc_lo) and close >= prev_poc_lo
    armed_short := false

// ===== PIVOTS =====
float pivot_low_val  = ta.pivotlow(low, pivot_len, pivot_len)
float pivot_high_val = ta.pivothigh(high, pivot_len, pivot_len)

bool pivot_low_confirmed  = not na(pivot_low_val)
bool pivot_high_confirmed = not na(pivot_high_val)

// ===== REVERSAL LOGIC =====
var bool rev_long_active = false
var int rev_long_bars = 0
var bool rev_short_active = false
var int rev_short_bars = 0

// Update reversal bars
if rev_long_active
    rev_long_bars -= 1
    if rev_long_bars <= 0
        rev_long_active := false

if rev_short_active
    rev_short_bars -= 1
    if rev_short_bars <= 0
        rev_short_active := false

// Detect Stop Out
// We need to know if the previous bar had a position and it closed due to stop.
// Since process_orders_on_close=true, the exit happens at the close.
// We can check if position size changed from non-zero to zero.
int prev_pos = strategy.position_size[1]
int curr_pos = strategy.position_size

bool pos_closed = prev_pos != 0 and curr_pos == 0

if pos_closed and use_post_stop_reversal
    // Determine if it was a stop out
    // For Long: low <= long_stop (approx)
    // For Short: high >= short_stop (approx)
    // Note: long_stop/short_stop are calculated based on current position, which is now 0.
    // We need to use the stop price from the previous bar or entry price.
    // strategy.position_avg_price is 0 now.
    // We can store the stop price when entering.
    
    // Let's use a variable to store the active stop price
    var float active_long_stop = na
    var float active_short_stop = na
    
    // This logic is tricky because we need to know the stop price of the closed trade.
    // I will add variables to track the stop price of the current/last trade.
    
    // Re-evaluating: I will add `var float last_long_stop` and `var float last_short_stop`
    // and update them on entry.
    
    // For now, let's assume if it closed, and it was a long, we check if low touched the stop.
    // But we don't have the stop price stored in a var yet.
    // I will add the vars below in the entry section and reference them here? No, order matters.
    // I will move the reversal detection to after entry logic or use a different method.
    
    // Alternative: Check if `low` (for long) was <= `strategy.position_avg_price[1] - stop_dollars/pv`
    // `strategy.position_avg_price[1]` is the entry price of the closed trade.
    
    if prev_pos > 0
        float prev_entry = strategy.position_avg_price[1]
        float prev_stop  = prev_entry - stop_dollars / pv
        if low <= prev_stop
            rev_short_active := true
            rev_short_bars := reversal_window_bars
            rev_long_active := false
            rev_long_bars := 0
    else if prev_pos < 0
        float prev_entry = strategy.position_avg_price[1]
        float prev_stop  = prev_entry + stop_dollars / pv
        if high >= prev_stop
            rev_long_active := true
            rev_long_bars := reversal_window_bars
            rev_short_active := false
            rev_short_bars := 0

// ===== ENTRY LOGIC =====
// Conditions for Long Entry
bool long_entry_cond = false
if in_session and strategy.position_size == 0 and not na(prev_poc_hi) and close > prev_poc_hi and pivot_low_confirmed
    // Standard Arm
    if armed_long
        long_entry_cond := true
    // Reversal
    else if rev_long_active and trend_long and delta_bull
        long_entry_cond := true

// Conditions for Short Entry
bool short_entry_cond = false
if in_session and strategy.position_size == 0 and not na(prev_poc_lo) and close < prev_poc_lo and pivot_high_confirmed
    // Standard Arm
    if armed_short
        short_entry_cond := true
    // Reversal
    else if rev_short_active and trend_short and delta_bear
        short_entry_cond := true

// Execute Entries
if long_entry_cond
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
    // Clear reversal flags on entry
    rev_long_active := false
    rev_long_bars := 0
    rev_short_active := false
    rev_short_bars := 0
    // Disarm
    armed_long := false
    armed_short := false

else if short_entry_cond
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)
    // Clear reversal flags on entry
    rev_long_active := false
    rev_long_bars := 0
    rev_short_active := false
    rev_short_bars := 0
    // Disarm
    armed_long := false
    armed_short := false

// ===== PLOTS =====
plot(vwma_val, "VWMA", color=color.new(color.blue, 0), linewidth=2)

float plo  = not na(poc_lo) ? poc_lo : na
float ppoc = not na(poc_price) ? poc_price : na
float phi  = not na(poc_hi) ? poc_hi : na

plot_lo  = plot(plo, "POC Low", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)
plot_poc = plot(ppoc, "POC", color.yellow, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=1)
plot_hi  = plot(phi, "POC High", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)

color channel_fill = na
if not na(poc_delta_pct)
    if poc_delta_pct > min_delta_pct
        channel_fill := color.new(color.green, 90)
    else if poc_delta_pct < -min_delta_pct
        channel_fill := color.new(color.red, 90)

fill(plot_lo, plot_hi, channel_fill)

plotshape(long_entry_cond, "Long Signal", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.lime, size=size.small)
plotshape(short_entry_cond, "Short Signal", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.red, size=size.small)

plot(not na(poc_delta_pct) ? poc_delta_pct : na, "POC Delta %", color.orange, display=display.data_window)
